source_snapshot.items: GFX Stress - rocBLAS Based Workload - AGFHC Max Power
source_snapshot.procedure: Run AGFHC gfx_maxpower while a separate `amd-smi monitor -w 5` records each GPU's utilization and power.
source_snapshot.criteria: AGFHC success, no miscompare and no new relevant dmesg failure; explicit FAIL on any of those.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL dual commands but insecure, lacks stable per-GPU map, quantitative power/thermal/cooling limits, complete monitor integrity and RAS/system deltas.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires adequate cooling, approved recipe, full-window identity-bound monitoring and bounded high-power recovery.

old_problem: AGFHC/AMD-SMI versions, per-GPU identity, power/temperature/utilization and platform cooling limits, monitor-gap rules and RAS/system-error policy are absent. Source clears logs and DeepSeek's dual SSH does not prove that every intended GPU was monitored for the whole max-power run.
disposition_reason: The rocBLAS-based gfx_maxpower stimulus and three acceptance dimensions are clear. Exact tool versions, quantitative platform envelope and error policy are runtime Project Configuration under ED-15. Every GPU is bound by immutable identity, monitored from before start through post-run, and any gap or limit breach invalidates the run; logs are preserved and no retry is allowed.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2063, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal pending row Functionality 2065 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00019-V002 / df740a7eb897398f was directly read from XLSX and the locked queue; intervening row 2064 is not in this formal queue.
Aggregate workload continuation cannot prove all GPUs remain present; each monitor sample needs stable UUID/BDF identity and gap detection.
AGFHC success, no miscompare and zero disallowed dmesg/RAS/BMC delta are independent from power/thermal compliance.
Five-second monitoring must span pre-start, full workload and post-stop; quantitative per-GPU/platform power, temperature and cooling limits are owner-approved and not inferred.
Adequate cooling/power headroom and dedicated no-load maintenance are preconditions; any GPU loss or limit breach stops without retry.
No AGFHC/amd-smi run, max-power stress, login, monitoring, log clear, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Identity-bound AGFHC rocBLAS max-power workload and platform-envelope validation
test_case.purpose: Drive every intended GPU with the approved gfx_maxpower recipe while complete five-second identity-bound utilization/power monitoring and preserved health logs prove success, no miscompare and compliance with the platform cooling/power envelope.
required_package: Exact row-2063 variant plus SUT/GPU UUID/BDF/index topology, driver/firmware and baseline health
Approved AGFHC gfx_maxpower and AMD-SMI versions/checksums and success/miscompare semantics
Per-GPU utilization/power/temperature limits and platform PSU/cooling/ambient/fan envelope
RAS/kernel/BMC baseline-to-window error policy and five-second monitor gap/timestamp rules
Dedicated no-load authorization, adequate power/cooling, aborts, evidence storage and console recovery
test_case.test_command: HIGH-POWER STRESS-GATED; preserve logs and map every AMD-SMI index to immutable UUID/BDF. Validate tools, cooling/power headroom, limits and dedicated no-load window. Start `amd-smi monitor -w 5` before workload, verify all mapped GPUs/timestamps and obtain authorization. Run exact `agfhc -t gfx_maxpower` once while retaining complete outputs and monitoring GPU utilization/power/temperature, PSU/fans/ambient, RAS/kernel/BMC and system stability through post-stop. Evaluate success, miscompare, error deltas and envelope independently. Stop on gap/fault/limit; no clear or rerun.
test_case.expected_result: AGFHC completes with approved success and no miscompare; every mapped GPU remains present and continuously monitored at five-second cadence, within signed power/temperature/utilization and platform cooling limits, with no new disallowed dmesg/RAS/BMC or system-stability error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved tools/map/envelope, complete monitor lifetime, AGFHC success, no miscompare and zero disallowed health/error delta. FAIL on failure/miscompare, missing GPU/sample gap, power/thermal/cooling violation, GPU loss or new disallowed log/RAS event. Missing limits/package/approval is NOT READY; workload success alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Max-power stress requires explicit authorization, adequate verified PSU/cooling/ambient and no competing GPU workload.
Monitor every immutable GPU plus platform power/fans/thermal continuously; stop on gap, loss or limit.
Preserve complete outputs and baseline/post logs; no clearing or insecure access.
One exact run only; no automatic retry after high-power anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash, tool checksums and immutable GPU map
Signed per-GPU/platform power/thermal/utilization/cooling limits and authorization
Pre health/error/power/cooling baseline and complete five-second monitor stream
Per-GPU plus platform envelope and RAS/kernel/BMC delta analysis
No-clear/no-rerun audit, recovery state and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On failure, miscompare, monitor gap, GPU loss or envelope violation, stop the workload and preserve all first-failure streams. Quiesce GPUs and use only approved cooling/service recovery under human control; do not rerun or clear evidence.

source_conflict.reason: Immutable full-window per-GPU monitoring and signed quantitative envelope resolve qualitative max-power and log-clearing gaps while retaining workload/miscompare/error coverage.

blocked.reason: The workload, evidence and recovery are complete; tool/map/quantitative limits are runtime Project inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Tool versions, immutable GPU map, success/miscompare and error policy, power/thermal/utilization/cooling limits, authorization, storage and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED TO IDENTITY-BOUND MAX-POWER ENVELOPE TEST; NO TOOL RUN, HIGH-POWER STRESS, LOGIN, MONITORING, LOG CLEAR, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
